title: Summoning hotel records, call data to prove adultery does not violate right to privacy: Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court on July 2 upheld a Delhi High Court judgment holding that directing production of hotel booking records and call detail records (CDRs) to establish a charge of adultery in matrimonial proceedings does not violate the right to privacy.A Bench of Justices Manmohan and K Vinod Chandran affirmed the May 10, 2023 judgment of the Delhi High Court, which had rejected a husband’s challenge to a family court order directing production of records from a Jaipur hotel where he was alleged
